[A532] REVIEW READY

Head: `bed5f47785839800bb640d7c747f5435f84ab5a3`, branch `pp148-notify-spacing`. Not pushed.

Round 1b amended is complete. `415a9fd` is preserved; `4ed463b` adds the required `--no-ff` merge of `ead80360`. Both spacing and arm-queue flags remain in the merged bench. The only subsequent fix is the README's seven-section count and timer-defaults invocation at `bed5f47`.

- Every processor suite, all six `pp_top` builds, `aecp_notify`, `acmp_listener`, lint, documentation/matrix checks and Yosys pass at base `ead80360` and head, rc 0. Suites: 1,021,627 to 1,021,640 checks, exactly upstream's +142 and this lane's +13. Compiled inputs at `4ed463b` equal the final head's; documentation checks were repeated at the final head.
- All ten campaigns pass at base and head, rc 0. Head: notify 7 controls + 53 killed; ctr 1 + 17; aecp 6 + 61; acmp 4 + 33; d3 6 + 110; dispatch 4 + 40; GSI 22 passing campaign records; name write 3; ADP 43; MAAP 32. All six new mutants fail their named CS/TW checks. The two intended shared failure-count changes remain notify 12 to 7 and ctr 3 to 4; all other failure counts agree.
- AQ has three extra ADP timer arms (8,270 to 8,273 in isolation; 8,280 to 8,283 in the default build). Traces place the cause at U9's deferred update, now 18 ms later under the send-spacing rule, shifting later PRNG draws and ADP advertisements. Other faces' arm counts, forced-drive coverage, AQ checks and ACMP campaign records agree. HANDOFF records the trace and numeric-only diagnostic differences.
- All five parent patches apply in order at dev `6c22d3ca`. Gate 15 passes with processor pin `bed5f477`, rc 0: every simulation leg, render controls 6/6 and gmstep controls 6/6. All 11,466 check/info/verdict lines match the original accepted head. The scratch parent remains uncommitted and unpushed.
- The original OOC 1x1 result remains -14 LUT, +1 FF, retained under the targeted re-measure rule; notify RTL is identical to that measured head. No port, parameter or register change.

HANDOFF.md and PR-BODY.md are updated, with current suite, build, campaign and parent tables plus hashes/sizes for the raw evidence. Processor #158 remains listed under What remains and is unchanged.
